info.title: Shillinq Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas for the Shillinq application.

x-openregister.description: Shillinq — open-source business administration suite for Dutch SMB, ZZP, and government.

example.title: Example
example.description: Example schema — replace with your app's actual schemas.

title.description: The title of the example object

KorRegime.title: KOR Regime
KorRegime.description: KOR (Kleine Ondernemersregeling) opt-in/opt-out regime per Wet OB 1968 art. 25. Tracks YTD revenue against the €20.000 omzetdrempel for MKB and ZZP administrations.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this KOR regime.

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the KOR regime.

currentCalendarYear.description: The calendar year tracked by ytdRevenue.

ytdRevenue.description: Year-to-date revenue derived via x-openregister-calculations from Invoice (T2) within the calendar year.

thresholdAmount.description: Statutory threshold (currently €20.000); read from kor-thresholds-2026.json seed.

warningPercentage.description: Default 80 (warning fires at 80% of threshold); from seed.

notes.description: Operator-authored context (e.g. 'Opt-out due to ICP-omzet uitsluiting').

outside.label: Outside KOR
outside.description: Administration is not opted into KOR. Default state for all eligible administrations.

opted-in.label: Opted In
opted-in.description: Administration is opted into KOR. YTD revenue is being tracked against the omzetdrempel.

threshold-warning.label: Threshold Warning (80%)
threshold-warning.description: YTD revenue has reached 80% of the omzetdrempel. Warning notification has been issued.

threshold-exceeded.label: Threshold Exceeded
threshold-exceeded.description: YTD revenue has reached or exceeded the omzetdrempel (€20.000). Opt-out action required.

opted-out.label: Opted Out
opted-out.description: Administration has exited KOR. A JournalEntry (state: pending) has been created for accountant review.

opt-in.label: Opt in to KOR
opt-in.description: Operator opts the administration into KOR for the current calendar year.

warn-threshold.label: Threshold warning (80%)
warn-threshold.description: Automatic: fires when ytdRevenue reaches warningPercentage % of thresholdAmount.

exceed-threshold.label: Threshold exceeded
exceed-threshold.description: Automatic: fires when ytdRevenue reaches or exceeds thresholdAmount.

year-rollover-reset.label: Calendar year rollover
year-rollover-reset.description: Fires on Jan 1 when currentCalendarYear increments and ytdRevenue resets to 0.

opt-out-from-exceeded.label: Opt out (threshold exceeded)
opt-out-from-exceeded.description: Operator or auto-trigger opts out after threshold is exceeded. Creates JournalEntry in state: pending.

opt-out-from-opted-in.label: Opt out voluntarily
opt-out-from-opted-in.description: Operator opts out before threshold is reached.

re-enter-outside.label: Re-enter (after 3-year lock-out)
re-enter-outside.description: Operator re-enters eligibility after the 3-year KOR lock-out per Wet OB 1968 art. 25 lid 3.

opt-out-from-exceeded.description: Create a KOR-vrijval JournalEntry template in state: pending for operator + accountant approval. NEVER auto-posted per REQ-KOR-006.

ytdRevenue.description: Sum of Invoice.totalAmountExclVat for the same administrationId within currentCalendarYear.

adr031Exception.reason: Cross-period (year-to-date) aggregation may not be expressible declaratively by OR's calculation engine. Thin single-method PHP guard (~30 LOC, no state) is the ADR-031 exception path. Resolved in implementing cycle opsx-ff discovery.

threshold-warning-notification.template: KOR-omzet bedraagt €{{ytdRevenue}} ({{ytdRevenuePercentage}}% van de drempel). Drempelwaarschuwing voor administratie {{administrationId}}.

threshold-exceeded-notification.template: KOR-omzetdrempel overschreden: €{{ytdRevenue}} ≥ €{{thresholdAmount}}. Opt-out vereist voor administratie {{administrationId}}.

opted-out-notification.template: KOR opt-out verwerkt voor administratie {{administrationId}}. Een journaalpost (status: in behandeling) is aangemaakt voor beoordeling.

kor-status.title: KOR Status
kor-status.description: Shows current KOR regime state, YTD revenue progress against omzetdrempel, and warning/exceeded indicators.

KorThreshold.title: KOR Threshold
KorThreshold.description: Versioned statutory KOR threshold record per Wet OB 1968 art. 25 lid 1. Loaded from kor-thresholds-2026.json seed.

thresholdAmount.description: Statutory omzetdrempel in EUR (currently €20.000 per Wet OB 1968 art. 25 lid 1).

warningPercentage.description: Warning percentage (default 80): warning notification fires when ytdRevenue reaches this percentage of thresholdAmount.

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year this threshold record applies to.

effectiveFrom.description: Start of the period during which this threshold record is active.

effectiveTo.description: End of the period during which this threshold record is active. Null = open-ended.

citation.description: Statutory citation for the threshold amount.

Account.title: Account
Account.description: A hierarchical chart-of-accounts entry conforming to the RGS (Referentie Grootboek Schema) standard for Dutch bookkeeping.

accountNumber.description: RGS-style account code (e.g. '1000', '4100'). Unique within an administration.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this account's base currency.

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber for hierarchy navigation.

isClosingAccount.description: Designates this as the administration's single closing account for period-end equity absorption.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this account. Scopes uniqueness of accountNumber.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the account.

description.description: Operator-authored free-text description of the account.

vatApplicable.description: Whether VAT/BTW applies to transactions posted to this account.

active.label: Active
active.description: Fully usable for new GL postings.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable and referenceable by existing postings, but rejected as the target of new GL lines.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only — no new postings, no edits; remains queryable.

block.label: Block account
block.description: Prevent new postings against this account.

unblock.label: Unblock account
unblock.description: Re-enable new postings against this account.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive account
archiveFromActive.description: Move to historical archive. Requires zero open balance.

archiveFromBlocked.label: Archive account
archiveFromBlocked.description: Move to historical archive from blocked state. Requires zero open balance.
